traditional: A soft contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts supports action, conflict, and heat - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Mind meets drive. A sharp, restless intellect that attacks problems rather than mulling them, and doesn't shy from debate. The trine makes this a natural strength: Quick, incisive thinking and confident argument. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Thinking and drive flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what thinking and drive have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
base: Clear direction can save a decision from another round of discussion when the next action is already obvious.

readerCopy.body: Clear direction can save a decision from another round of discussion when the next action is already obvious. When Mercury trines Mars, thought and action reinforce each other, making decisions, instructions, and difficult conversations easier to execute quickly. You may notice that the shortest useful sentence is enough when the responsibility, task, and next step are already clear. Speed works best when it comes from clarity rather than pressure.
